cases.summary: IllegalReferenceCountException with compression enabled but not used if HttpResponse implements HttpContent and not LastHttpContent
cases.description: Turns out my fix for https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/11092 was incomplete. It fixes the case where the content is compressed, but it will also fail if the client does not specify an Accept-Encoding.
